description: This file defines the class EmailsViewPopup, which extends ViewPopup and is used for the email popup view in the SuiteCRM system. It primarily sets up the class with a property for an Email bean, and includes the standard security check at the start.

classes.name: EmailsViewPopup
classes.description: A view class for the email popup interface, extending the ViewPopup class and containing a property for the Email bean.
